term: divine founding: direct calibration and envoy-inclusive calibration
definition: For fixed Signature σ, Agency A and direct : Being → Society → Prop, direct g c records a constitutive founding act by principal g. The minimal ImmediateOnlyReading calibrates FoundedAsTeachingAuthority to direct, only for IsGod candidates. EnvoyInclusiveReading calibrates it to direct or the exact event FoundedInMandate jesus g c ∧ CommissionedToTeach jesus c. The relations may overlap: a principal can issue a charter personally while an authorized envoy also contributes to establishing the same society. Neither calibration encodes Jesus≠g, actual mandate holding, or every other envoy. ExclusiveImmediateReading adds the explicit Jesus-scope condition that such an envoy event excludes direct founding. NamedReadingCoverage is an open disjunction of the two minimal calibrations; AdditionalFoundingReading is the negation of both, and can admit or reject the old envoy bridge.
note: Analyst meaning comparison prompted by the owner’s definition-proposition/fork method. No reading is adopted or sourced by this batch. Ordinary principal/representative acts illustrate the distinction, not a general agency-composition law or a historical event. The metaphysical applicability of direct founding and the scope of permitted mediation remain OPEN. The old immediate-without-creature glossary is stronger than the minimal direct calibration; the new exclusive condition encodes only its Jesus-event fragment. Same extension is not philosophical or historical identity. Existing Agency/Signature relations and all frozen Challenges remain unchanged.
